notes:
### New
- **OpenCrate passes its playlist changes on to Rekordbox and Engine DJ.** Once
  you use OpenCrate as your main library, a new playlist or folder, a rename,
  a move, songs added or removed, or a new order made in OpenCrate are written
  into both apps by themselves, with a backup first. If an app is open the
  change waits and is written when it closes. Deleting a playlist is never
  passed on unless you turn on **Mirror deletions too** (Settings → Sync →
  Passing changes on): then a playlist or folder you delete in OpenCrate is
  deleted in both apps as well (songs are never deleted there). Switch the
  passing off in the same place. Star ratings, track info (title, artist,
  genre …), cues, loops and beatgrids you change in OpenCrate are passed on
  the same way once you've made OpenCrate your main library. If Rekordbox or
  Engine DJ is open, they wait and are written when it closes.
  Playlist changes made in Rekordbox or Engine DJ come back too: when you close
  the app (and when OpenCrate starts), new playlists and added songs are taken
  into OpenCrate, and with **Mirror deletions too** deleted playlists and
  removed songs follow as well. The other app gets them from OpenCrate.
  Changes from before you made OpenCrate your main library aren't compared.
  The same goes for the data of your songs: star ratings, track info, cues,
  loops and beatgrids changed in Rekordbox or Engine DJ come into OpenCrate
  and on to the other app, the order of songs in a playlist follows, and songs
  you add there come in too. If OpenCrate has a change of its own waiting for
  a song, that change goes first. **Settings → Sync → Keep everything in step**
  switches all of this on or off in one go; the single options below it stay
  available, and with them off your libraries stay apart until you sync by
  hand.

- **Sync from OpenCrate into Engine DJ.** In Sync → Libraries, **From** now
  also offers OpenCrate's own library: its songs, playlists and the cues,
  loops and grids each song uses go into Engine DJ with the usual preview,
  backup and Undo, and Engine DJ then counts as in step with OpenCrate
  (syncing again only passes on what changed).

- **Sync from OpenCrate into Rekordbox.** Pick OpenCrate as **From** and
  Rekordbox as **To**: songs Rekordbox doesn't have are added, and OpenCrate's
  playlists and their songs are merged in, with a preview, a backup first and
  Undo. Merge only adds; **Rewrite** makes Rekordbox's playlists match OpenCrate's
  exactly (playlists, folders and entries OpenCrate lacks are removed, with a
  warning; songs stay). New songs come in with
  their tags and rating, not analysed: Rekordbox makes the BPM, grid and
  waveform when you analyse them there. Rekordbox must be closed.

### Fixed
- **Drag and drop lands where you point.** Moving tracks inside a playlist
  follows the pointer: the top half of a row puts them above it, the bottom
  half below, and the line shows exactly where they'll go. Playlists and
  folders in the sidebar can now go above or below any other (not only
  below), and into a folder when you drop on its middle.
- **Exporting to a stick after removing playlists or songs in Rekordbox** no
  longer refuses outright when a playlist the stick keeps holds songs that
  aren't in your library any more. The preview names those playlists and
  how many songs each would lose, and a tick box lets the export go ahead
  (the music files stay on the stick); untick it to import them first.
- **Right-click → Add to playlist** now shows the result at once: the playlist's
  count in the sidebar and the open list update when it's saved (dragging
  already did).
